extension.summary: Repository of small, hand-picked Kodi addon fixes
extension.description: Hosts addons that have been forked and patched for a specific CoreELEC/Aeon Nox 5 setup. Currently: CU LRC Lyrics (DC Version) - lyrics sync/scraper/OK-OSD fixes; DC Artist Artwork DL - rotating artist fanart background service; Aeon Nox 5 Skin Fixes - companion skin patches both of those need; and a network watchdog for boots where the LAN doesn't come up on its own. See the repository README for the full list, plus manual-install remote keymaps that aren't installable addons.
extension.news: 1.1.0: renamed repository from "xDereCx Kodi Fixes" to "DereC Kodi Fixes". 1.0.0: initial release, includes CU LRC Lyrics (DC Version).

extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork with OK/OSD, sync, and scraper reliability fixes
extension.description: Fork of CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original by Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) with several fixes applied on top: (1) the OK button on the remote no longer gets swallowed by the lyrics dialog's stolen input focus, and pressing OK now shows the music OSD/menu, with the lyrics view automatically reopening afterwards instead of requiring a full navigation reset; (2) manual sync offset correction (up/down during timed lyrics) restored after that same focus change had silently broken it; (3) plain (untimed) txt lyrics no longer get stuck showing only the first line forever; (4) several scraper reliability fixes - a crash in the lrclib.net scraper that could silently abort the entire remaining fallback chain, a Music163 false-positive that returned songwriter-credit-only text as if it were real lyrics, and duration-aware filtering so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) gets rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. Automatically disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on startup if found installed and enabled, since the two conflict as lyrics service. See this repository's README and the version history below for details.
extension.news: 1.7.0: now declares script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix as a real add-on dependency, so Kodi installs it automatically alongside this one instead of it being an easy-to-miss separate manual step - it still needs to be run once from Program add-ons to actually patch the skin (can't auto-patch a third-party skin without the user's OK). Also now auto-disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on every Kodi startup if it's found installed and enabled, since the two can't both run as the lyrics service - previously this conflict had to be resolved manually. 1.6.0: up/down during timed lyrics now opens the same on-screen slider dialog used by the context menu's "Sync" option, instead of silently nudging a hidden offset and popping a "Sync offset: +0.5s" notification that didn't say which direction was which. The slider dialog has a static "LATER <---- SYNC OFFSET ----> EARLIER" legend plus a live readout ("Lyrics play Xs earlier/later"/"In sync"), auto-closes after 4s of no input, and the slider step matches the old 0.5s nudge. 1.5.2: clear the previous song's lyrics from the screen immediately on song change, instead of leaving the old lyrics visible for the few seconds get_lyrics() can take to run scraper lookups for the new song. 1.5.1: fixed the same native Kodi crash as 1.5.0 recurring, because 1.5.0 only excluded the ".offset(N)" + "MusicPlayer.Duration" combination while the next-song lyrics prefetch (Song.next(), added for the duration-aware filtering in 1.4.0) still queried Title/Artist/Lyrics/Property with ".offset(1)" - it turns out any MusicPlayer/Player info label combined with ".offset(N)" is unsafe on this Kodi build, not just Duration. Song.next() is now disabled entirely (returns None) instead of trying to fix each individual label one crash at a time - prefetching next-song lyrics was a minor head-start optimization, not essential, since lyrics still get fetched reactively the moment the next track actually starts. 1.5.0: fixed a Kodi crash (native SIGSEGV inside CGUIInfoManager::GetMultiInfoLabel, called via xbmc.getInfoLabel from Python) observed shortly after Song.by_offset() queried "MusicPlayer.offset(N).Duration" for the prefetched next-song lookup added in 1.4.0's duration-aware filtering. That exact info label combination (Duration + a non-zero offset) is far less established than plain "MusicPlayer.Duration", so duration is now only fetched for the current song (offset 0) rather than trying to root-cause a native crash inside Kodi itself. 1.4.0: restored manual lyrics sync correction - the old scrolltosync() feature relied on the lyrics list having native focus (self.controlId == 110) to read a manually-navigated line's timestamp, which was dead code ever since focus was disabled in 1.0.0 for the OK-button/OSD fix, so up/down did nothing for out-of-sync (but correct-edit) timed lyrics. Up/down during timed lyrics now directly nudges a saved offset (with an on-screen readout) instead of depending on focus. Also added duration-aware filtering to the lrclib and musixmatchlrc scrapers so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) with a different length is rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. 1.3.0: fixed plain (untimed) txt lyrics getting stuck showing only the first line forever - a regression from the 1.0.0 OK-button/OSD fix, which disabled focus on the lyrics list so onFocus() (and the up/down scroll handling that depended on it) never fired. Timed LRC lyrics were unaffected since those auto-scroll via a timer regardless of focus. Up/down now moves the txt lyrics selection directly. 1.2.0: fixed a false-positive match in the Music163 scraper - it sometimes only has songwriter/composer credit lines in its lyric DB (e.g. "作词 : ..." / "作曲 : ...") with no actual lyrics, but returned them as if they were valid, blocking the real Genius/musixmatch result from being tried. Now checks the returned lyric actually has content beyond credit lines. 1.1.0: fixed a bug where the lrclib.net scraper could crash with an uncaught TypeError when the API returned an unexpected (non-list) response, which silently aborted the entire remaining lyrics search cascade (musixmatch, genius, supermusic, etc. never got tried). The lrclib scraper is now defensive against bad responses, and both scraper loops in gui.py now catch exceptions per-provider so one broken source can no longer block the rest. 1.0.0: fork of upstream 6.7.1. Fixed OK button being swallowed by lyrics dialog focus; OK now shows OSD and lyrics auto-resume when OSD closes.

extension.summary: Patches Aeon Nox 5 for CU LRC Lyrics + DC Artist Artwork DL compatibility
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons (after skin.aeon.nox.5 and, ideally, script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart are installed). Patches up to 3 of skin.aeon.nox.5's own files: (1) 1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - hides the topbar.png control that draws a dark band over lyrics text, and adds the rotating-fanart background control used by DC Artist Artwork DL; (2) 1080i/MusicVisualisation.xml - hides the skin's own static fanart background so it can't cover the rotating one; (3) 1080i/Font.xml - fixes missing Slovak/Czech diacritics in 2 of the 5 lyrics display fonts. Each file gets a one-time backup (.bak) before patching; re-running is a no-op for anything already applied. Restart Kodi afterwards for the changes to take effect.
extension.news: 1.1.0: now patches all 3 skin files this repo ships overrides for (script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml, MusicVisualisation.xml, Font.xml) in one run with a single combined confirmation, instead of only the lyrics topbar file - the other two were previously manual-copy-only (skin-overrides/) and easy to miss, and script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart now declare this addon as a real <requires> dependency so Kodi installs it alongside them automatically. 1.0.3: added missing icon declaration. 1.0.2: fixed extension point (was the invalid bare "xbmc.python", now "xbmc.python.script" - that bare string is only valid in a requires/import, not as an addon's own type). 1.0.1: fixed repository install (bundled skin file was confusing Kodi's addon-type detection inside the zip). 1.0.0: initial release.

addon.name: CoreELEC: Network watchdog (connman restart on boot)

extension.summary: Restarts connman if no LAN IP shows up within 60s of boot
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons. Installs a systemd oneshot service (network-watchdog.service) and its script to /storage/.config/ on this CoreELEC box. At every boot it waits up to 60s for a 192.168.x.x LAN IP (ignoring WireGuard/OpenVPN/PPP tunnel interfaces); if none appears, it restarts connman and checks again. Fixes boots where the network never comes up on its own. Idempotent - running it again just confirms the files are already installed and the service enabled. Not a Kodi/skin fix - a system-level boot reliability fix, same delivery mechanism (a one-time Program add-on) as the other patches in this repo.
extension.news: 1.0.0: initial release - packages the network-watchdog systemd service confirmed working on x96max+.

extension.summary: Real fanart backgrounds for the currently playing music artist
extension.description: Lightweight replacement for Artist Slideshow. Looks up TheAudioDB / fanart.tv / Deezer for the currently playing artist and exposes the result via Window(Visualisation).Property(ArtistSlideshow.Image), compatible with the existing Aeon Nox 5 MusicVisualisation.xml patch. Runs as a proper Kodi background service (started once at Kodi startup) instead of a re-invoked script, avoiding the stuck/zombie "already running" issue.
extension.news: 1.7.0: now declares script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix as a real add-on dependency (this addon does nothing visible without that skin patch applied), so Kodi installs it automatically alongside this one instead of it being an easy-to-miss separate manual step - it still needs to be run once from Program add-ons to actually patch the skin. 1.6.0: now auto-switches to the visualisation screen (rotating fanart + lyrics) whenever audio playback starts, instead of leaving whichever library/browsing screen was open beforehand - so starting an album from anywhere in Kodi jumps straight to the now-playing view. 1.5.0: fixed fanart appearing permanently frozen on one image whenever CU LRC Lyrics is showing (i.e. most of the time). Root cause: the visible screen during playback is usually the lyrics dialog window, not the plain visualisation window - Kodi only continues to actively redraw the topmost open window, so the visualisation window's own image control (bound to our rotating property) stopped getting refreshed the moment the lyrics dialog opened, freezing on whichever image was showing at that instant, even though the underlying property kept updating correctly every 12s. Also tried routing updates through Kodi's native library fanart field via AudioLibrary.SetArtistDetails, but Player.Art(fanart) turned out to be a one-time snapshot per track (not live), so that alone doesn't fix mid-song rotation either - kept it anyway since a real per-track native fanart is still a nice side benefit and survives library rescans reasonably (re-asserted every rotation cycle). The actual fix (paired with a companion aeon-nox-5 skin patch, see skin-overrides/) adds a background image control directly inside the lyrics dialog's own XML, bound to the same rotating property, so it refreshes as part of that window's own active render loop instead of relying on the frozen window underneath. 1.4.0: fixed the artist fanart rotation permanently freezing on one image - Rotator.run() had no exception handling, so any single unhandled error (e.g. a stale path from a race with a fresh download) silently killed the rotation thread for the rest of the Kodi session. Now logs and keeps looping instead. 1.3.0: fixed addon settings showing values with no labels at all (blank rows) - the settings.xml used inline text for each setting's label instead of a numbered string ID resolved via strings.po, which this Kodi build silently fails to render for addon settings. Added a proper resources/language/resource.language.en_gb/strings.po and pointed each setting's label at its string ID, matching how the other working addons in this repo do it. 1.2.0: fixed a real bug - xbmc.Player().getPlayingFile() returns a musicdb://songs/... virtual URL (not a real path) when a track is played from the Kodi music library view, which silently broke library-folder saving (it always fell back to the private cache instead). Now resolves the real on-disk path via Player.GetItem's "file" property first. 1.1.0: added Deezer as a third image source (no API key needed) - mainly helps Slovak/Czech and other regional artists that TheAudioDB/fanart.tv don't have at all. Added an on-screen "searching for fanart..." notification on first fetch for a new artist, so it's clear something is happening during the initial download delay. 1.0.0: initial release.
